name: Poetry
overview: Scripture reveals poetry as a powerful means of worship and praise, exemplified by Moses and Miriam's songs celebrating the Lord's triumphant deliverance at the Red Sea. These sacred lyrics not only honor God's mighty acts but also express deep trust and virtue, as seen in the Proverbs 31 passage describing a woman whose value and faithfulness inspire confidence and goodness. Through poetic expression, the Bible communicates profound spiritual truths and heartfelt devotion to God.
